blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Taytay, Rizal recorded a heat index of 44.79 degrees Celsius on Friday, placing it in the danger category despite the onset of cool winds brought by the “amihan.” The local government’s Public Information Office (PIO) warned residents about health risks from prolonged exposure to extreme heat. The office urged residents to stay hydrated, avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight, and limit strenuous outdoor activities during the hottest hours of the day.
